Learn Arabic Online – Arabic Language

Home  >  Courses  > Learn Arabic Language 

Learn Arabic Online with Personalised Lessons

Our Arabic Language Course is designed for children, teenagers, and adults who want to learn Arabic in a structured and practical way from the comfort of home.

Whether you are a complete beginner, want to improve your Arabic speaking skills, need help with reading and writing, or want to develop a stronger understanding of Arabic for Quranic study, our online Arabic classes are adapted to the student’s current level and learning goals.

At Ilm World Academy, students learn through live online Arabic lessons with experienced teachers. Lessons focus on practical language skills, vocabulary, pronunciation, sentence formation, reading, writing, and communication.

Get Free Trail Now

WhatsApp Guidance

What You'll Learn in Arabic

Everyday Arabic Vocabulary

Build a useful vocabulary for everyday situations, conversations, family life, study, travel, and common communication.

Arabic Reading & Writing

Learn to recognise Arabic words, read sentences, and develop stronger Arabic writing skills through guided practice.

Speaking & Conversation

Practise forming sentences and communicating in Arabic with greater confidence through teacher-led conversations.

Grammar & Sentence Structure

Understand essential Arabic grammar and learn how words work together to form meaningful and grammatically correct sentences.

Why Learn Arabic Online?

Arabic is one of the world’s most widely spoken languages and has a unique place in Islamic education and culture. Learning Arabic can open the door to communication with Arabic speakers while also helping students engage more deeply with Arabic texts.

For Muslims, learning Arabic can also support Quranic and Islamic studies. Understanding common Arabic vocabulary, sentence structures, and grammatical concepts can make it easier to explore the language of the Quran rather than relying only on translation.

Our online Arabic language course provides students with the flexibility to learn from home while receiving direct guidance from a teacher.

Learning Arabic can help you:

  • Develop practical Arabic communication skills
  • Improve Arabic reading and writing
  • Build a stronger everyday Arabic vocabulary
  • Understand basic and intermediate grammar
  • Improve pronunciation and listening skills
  • Communicate more confidently in Arabic
  • Develop a foundation for further Arabic studies
  • Better understand Arabic texts and Islamic literature

Get Free Trail Now

Learn Arabic According to Your Level

Not every student starts learning Arabic from the same point. Some learners may already recognise Arabic letters, while others may be complete beginners.

Our lessons can be adjusted according to your existing knowledge and learning objectives.

Arabic for Complete Beginners

Start with the foundations of the Arabic language, including letters, sounds, vocabulary, basic words, and simple sentences.

Arabic Reading and Writing

Students who already recognise Arabic letters can progress towards reading words, sentences, and longer passages while developing their writing skills.

Arabic Speaking Practice

Develop your conversational Arabic through guided questions, vocabulary exercises, sentence building, and practical dialogue.

Arabic Grammar

Learn essential concepts such as nouns, verbs, pronouns, sentence structure, and other grammatical foundations as your level develops.

Arabic for Quranic Understanding

Students interested in understanding the language of the Quran can develop Arabic vocabulary and grammatical knowledge that supports further Quranic studies.

How Our Online Arabic Classes Work

Starting your Arabic learning journey is simple.

1. Book Your Free Trial

Begin by requesting your free trial class. This gives you an opportunity to experience our teaching approach before joining regular lessons.

2. Identify Your Arabic Level

The teacher gets an understanding of your current Arabic knowledge, reading ability, vocabulary, speaking skills, and learning objectives.

3. Follow a Personalised Learning Plan

Your lessons are organised according to your level and goals instead of expecting every learner to follow exactly the same pace.

4. Learn Through Live Lessons

Attend live online Arabic classes where you can interact directly with your teacher, ask questions, practise pronunciation, and work through exercises.

5. Practise Between Lessons

Regular practice helps reinforce new Arabic vocabulary, grammar, reading, and communication skills.

6. Build Your Skills Gradually

As your Arabic improves, lessons can progress towards more advanced vocabulary, conversation, reading comprehension, grammar, and written Arabic.

What Makes Our Arabic Classes Different?

Learning a language requires regular practice and interaction. At Ilm World Academy, our online Arabic lessons are designed to give students direct access to a teacher rather than relying only on recorded material.

Our Arabic course can complement your Quran education by helping you develop a broader understanding of Arabic vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, and reading.

If your primary goal is to improve your Quran recitation, you can also explore our Learn Quran with Tajweed Online course.

"Ilm World Academy has been an incredible experience for my children. The teachers are patient, professional, and make every lesson engaging. I've seen remarkable improvement in their Quran recitation and confidence."

Amina R., London, UK

"Finding a reliable online Quran academy wasn't easy until we joined Ilm World Academy. The one-to-one classes are well-structured, and the teacher's Tajweed expertise has made a huge difference."

Mohammed K, Sydney, Australia

"The flexible class timings fit perfectly around our family's schedule. My son genuinely looks forward to every lesson, and his Quran reading has improved beyond our expectations."

Sarah H., Manchester, UK

"The teachers are knowledgeable, kind, and truly dedicated to every student's progress. I highly recommend Ilm World Academy to anyone looking for quality online Quran classes."

Yusuf A., Montreal, Quebec

Personalised Arabic Learning

Lessons are adapted according to your current ability, whether you are starting from zero or already have some knowledge of Arabic.

Live Teacher Interaction

Students can ask questions, practise speaking, read aloud, and receive immediate guidance during their online Arabic class.

Male and Female Teachers

Male and female teachers are available, allowing students and families to select a suitable learning arrangement.

Arabic for Different Learning Goals

Whether you want to learn Arabic online for conversation, reading, writing, Islamic studies, Quranic understanding, travel, or personal development, your learning plan can be structured around your goals.

FAQs

Can I learn Arabic online as a complete beginner?

Yes. Our online Arabic classes can start from the basics, making them suitable for students who have little or no previous knowledge of Arabic.

Is this Arabic course suitable for children?

Yes. Arabic lessons can be adapted for children according to their age, existing knowledge, and learning goals.

Can adults learn Arabic online?

Absolutely. Adults can join Arabic classes at beginner, intermediate, or more advanced levels depending on their existing knowledge.

Will I learn to speak Arabic?

Speaking practice can be included in your lessons through vocabulary exercises, sentence formation, questions, conversations, and teacher-guided dialogue.

Can I learn Arabic for understanding the Quran?

Yes. Students interested in Quranic Arabic can develop vocabulary, grammar, reading, and comprehension skills that support their understanding of Arabic Quranic texts.

Do you teach Arabic reading and writing?

Yes. Depending on your level, lessons can include Arabic reading, writing, vocabulary, pronunciation, sentence formation, and grammar.

Do you offer male and female Arabic teachers?

Yes. Male and female teachers are available for students according to their preferences and requirements.

contentHtml:
Learn Noorani Qaida Online

Home  >  Courses  >  Noorani Qaida Online

Build a Strong Foundation for Quran Reading with Noorani Qaida

Our Noorani Qaida Online Course is designed for children, beginners, teenagers, and adults who want to learn how to read the Quran correctly from the very beginning.

At Ilm World Academy, students learn through live, personalised online Quran classes with experienced male and female teachers. Lessons are adjusted according to the student’s age, current reading ability, and learning pace.

The Noorani Qaida introduces students to Arabic letters, their sounds, joining letters, basic pronunciation, and essential reading rules before they progress to reading the Holy Quran.

Get Free Trail Now

WhatsApp Guidance

What You'll Learn

Recognise Arabic Letters Correctly

Learn to identify Arabic letters and understand how their shapes and sounds change in different positions.

Build a Strong Islamic Foundation for Your Child

Our Basic Islamic Education & Daily Duas for Kids course is designed to help children learn essential Islamic knowledge in a simple, engaging, and age-appropriate way.

Through live online lessons, children learn important Islamic teachings, daily duas, basic manners, Sunnah practices, and essential knowledge every Muslim child should know. Lessons are adapted to the child’s age, learning level, and ability to understand.

At Ilm World Academy, our experienced Quran and Islamic studies teachers guide children step by step, helping them develop a meaningful connection with Islam from an early age.

WhatsApp Guidance

What Your Child Will Learn

Essential Islamic Knowledge

Learn the basic beliefs, practices, and teachings that help children understand their identity as Muslims.

Daily Duas & Supplications

Memorise important daily duas for kids, including supplications for eating, sleeping, leaving home, entering the mosque, travelling, and other everyday situations.

Islamic Manners & Good Character

Learn the importance of kindness, respect, honesty, cleanliness, helping others, and good behaviour according to Islamic teachings.

Sunnah Practices

Introduce children to simple Sunnah practices and help them understand how these teachings can become part of their everyday lives.

What Is Basic Islamic Education for Kids?

Basic Islamic education gives children the foundational knowledge they need to understand and practise their faith in everyday life.

Children can learn about essential Islamic beliefs, worship, manners, duas, Sunnah, and important lessons from the Quran and Seerah in a structured and age-appropriate way.

Rather than simply memorising information, our lessons aim to help children understand why Islamic teachings matter and how they can apply them in daily life.

Our online Islamic classes for kids can cover areas such as:

  • Basic Islamic beliefs and principles
  • Five Pillars of Islam
  • Islamic manners and good character
  • Daily duas and supplications
  • Short Surahs and their basic meanings
  • Sunnah practices
  • Wudu and basic prayer guidance
  • Respect for parents, teachers, and elders
  • Cleanliness and personal responsibility
  • Basic knowledge from the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
  • Everyday Islamic etiquette
  • Allah says in the Quran: "Allah intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship."

Why Should Children Learn Islamic Studies Early?

Children develop habits and values from an early age. Introducing Islamic education gradually can help them become familiar with important teachings while making learning a natural part of their daily routine.

Learning Islamic studies for kids online can help children:

  • Understand the basic teachings of Islam
  • Memorise and use daily duas correctly
  • Develop good Islamic manners
  • Learn about the Sunnah
  • Build a stronger connection with their faith
  • Understand basic Islamic practices
  • Develop positive habits and character
  • Become more confident in asking questions about Islam

Getting started with your child’s Islamic education is simple.

1. Book a Free Trial

Start by booking your child’s free trial class. This allows you and your child to experience our online teaching approach before enrolling.

The teacher considers your child’s age, existing Islamic knowledge, memorisation ability, and learning needs.

3. Follow an Age-Appropriate Plan

Lessons are structured according to the child’s level so that Islamic concepts can be introduced gradually without overwhelming them.

4. Learn Through Live Classes

Children interact directly with their teacher during each lesson. They can ask questions, practise duas, and receive guidance throughout the class.

5. Practise at Home

Parents can help children revise duas, Islamic manners, and lessons between classes so that what they learn becomes part of their everyday routine.

Expert Quran & Islamic Studies Teachers

Lessons are designed around the child’s age and learning ability, making it easier for young students to understand and participate.

Personalised Learning

Learn from Anywhere

Our online Islamic classes are available for children and families in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Europe, and other countries.

What will my child learn in Basic Islamic Education classes?

Children can learn essential Islamic beliefs, daily duas, Islamic manners, Sunnah practices, basic worship, Seerah lessons, and other foundational Islamic knowledge appropriate for their age.

Children can begin learning basic Islamic concepts and duas from a young age. The lessons can be adapted according to the child’s age, understanding, and existing knowledge.

Yes. Children do not need advanced Islamic knowledge to begin. Lessons can start with simple concepts and gradually progress according to the student’s level.

Yes. Ilm World Academy serves students internationally, including families in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Europe, and other regions.

Can I memorise the Quran online?

Tajweed refers to the rules used to recite the Quran correctly, giving each Arabic letter its proper pronunciation, characteristics, and articulation.

When learning to read the Quran, simply recognising Arabic letters is not always enough. Correct pronunciation of letters, appropriate elongation, pauses, nasal sounds, and other Tajweed rules all contribute to accurate Quran recitation.

For this reason, learning Quran with Tajweed can help students:

  • Improve the pronunciation of Arabic letters
  • Learn the correct Makharij and Sifaat
  • Recite Quran more clearly and confidently

FAQs

How much do online Quran classes cost at Ilm World Academy?

At Ilm World Academy, our online Quran classes start from $29 per month and go up to $99 per month, depending on your selected course and the number of weekly sessions. We offer affordable plans for Quran learning for kids and adults, along with a free 3-day trial so you can experience our teaching before enrolling.

Does Ilm World Academy offer a free trial for online Quran classes?

Yes. Ilm World Academy provides a 100% free 3-day trial for all new students who want to learn Quran online. No credit card or advance payment is required. Simply book your trial, meet your qualified Quran teacher, and experience our personalized online Quran learning program before choosing a plan.

Who can join online Quran classes at Ilm World Academy?

Our online Quran academy welcomes students of all ages, including children, teenagers, and adults. We offer customized online Quran classes for kids starting from 4 years old, as well as advanced Quran courses for adults. Every lesson is tailored to the student’s age, learning level, and goals.

Which countries does Ilm World Academy cover?

Ilm World Academy provides online Quran classes worldwide, serving students across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, and many other countries. With flexible scheduling and 24/7 class availability, you can learn Quran online from anywhere, regardless of your time zone.

Does Ilm World Academy have female Quran teachers?

Yes. Ilm World Academy has experienced and certified female Quran teachers for sisters and young girls who prefer female instructors. During registration, you can request a female tutor for your online Quran classes, ensuring a comfortable and effective learning environment.

Are the Quran teachers at Ilm World Academy certified?

Yes. All Quran teachers at Ilm World Academy are highly qualified and carefully selected for their knowledge, teaching experience, and professionalism. Privacy Policy

Effective Date: July 2026

Welcome to Ilm World Academy (“we,” “our,” or “us”). Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you visit Ilm World Academy, use our website, or enroll in our online Quran classes.

By accessing or using our website, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

About Ilm World Academy

Ilm World Academy is a trusted online Quran academy dedicated to providing high-quality Quranic education and Islamic studies for students of all ages. We proudly serve students across the United Kingdom (UK), United States (USA), Canada, Australia, and learners from countries around the world through live online classes.

Information We Collect

When you use our website or contact us, we may collect information including:

  • Full name
  • Parent or guardian’s name (where applicable)
  • Email address
  • Phone or WhatsApp number
  • Country and city
  • Student’s age
  • Preferred course
  • Preferred class timings
  • Communication history
  • Technical information such as IP address, browser type, cookies, and device information

We only collect information necessary to provide our educational services and improve your experience.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Register students for online Quran classes
  • Schedule free trial classes
  • Respond to enquiries
  • Contact students regarding classes and schedules
  • Improve our educational services
  • Send important updates regarding courses
  • Provide customer support
  • Maintain internal records
  • Protect our website against fraud or misuse

We never sell your personal information.

Children’s Privacy

Many of our students are children. Personal information relating to children is collected only with the knowledge or consent of a parent or legal guardian.

Parents remain responsible for supervising their child’s online learning experience.

Cookies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Improve website performance
  • Remember user preferences
  • Analyze website traffic
  • Enhance user experience

You may disable cookies through your browser settings, although some website features may not function properly.

Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party services to operate our academy, including:

  • Website hosting
  • Email services
  • Video conferencing platforms
  • Payment processors
  • Analytics services

These providers only receive information necessary to perform their services and are expected to maintain appropriate security standards.

Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information from:

  • Unauthorized access
  • Loss
  • Misuse
  • Alteration
  • Disclosure

While we work hard to safeguard your information, no online transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

International Students

Ilm World Academy welcomes students worldwide. By enrolling in our online Quran classes, you understand that your information may be processed in accordance with this Privacy Policy regardless of your country of residence.

Payment Information

Payments are processed using secure payment methods. We do not store complete debit card or credit card information on our website.

Email & WhatsApp Cmmunication

By contacting us or submitting a form on our website, you agree that we may communicate with you through:

  • Email
  • WhatsApp
  • Phone calls
  • SMS (where applicable)

These communications may include class schedules, trial confirmations, course information, reminders, and customer support.

Data Retention

We retain your information only for as long as necessary to:

  • Provide educational services
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Resolve disputes
  • Maintain internal records

When information is no longer required, we take reasonable steps to securely delete or anonymize it.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access your personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your personal data
  • Withdraw consent where applicable
  • Request a copy of the information we hold about you

Requests may be submitted using the contact information provided below.

External Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of external websites.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, or business operations.

Any updates will be published on this page along with the revised effective date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us.
